about.title: The Person Behind the Code
about.description:
Hi, I’m Gavaskar — a third-year Computer Science student at Eastern University, Trincomalee Campus. I love turning ideas into small projects that actually work.

I’ve worked on a microservices-based medicinal plant system and a student accommodation app. Through these, I learned to think about how things work making apps that don’t just run, but run well.

I build websites and web apps with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, MERN stack, focusing on clean, responsive UI/UX. I handle deployment, perform testing, and ensure apps scale reliably.

services.title: Full Stack Development
services.description: I build scalable web applications using MERN stack and FastAPI. I focus on clean architecture, RESTful APIs, and responsive UI design.

services.title: Backend & API Design
services.description: I architect high-performance RESTful APIs and secure authentication systems. I’m skilled in optimizing database queries and designing data models that ensure system integrity

services.title: Frontend Development
services.description: I create modern, responsive interfaces using React.js and Tailwind CSS with a focus on performance and usability.

experience.description: I have hands-on experience managing the full development lifecycle from designing high-fidelity prototypes in Figma to implementing full-stack solutions. My work includes developing CRUD-based systems, architecting RESTful APIs, and exploring microservices. I am committed to writing clean code using version control and deploying reliable software that solves real-world challenges
